description_en: Creates a batch list of vulnerabilities that can be automatically fixed. After creation, the list is used for vulnerability selection in vulnerability fix tasks in the task center
description_zh: 批量创建可自动修复的漏洞列表，创建后用于任务中心的漏洞修复任务的漏洞列表选择
kebab_example: aliyun sas create-vul-auto-repair-config --type cve --vul-auto-repair-config-list AliasName=CVE-2018-25032:zlib_1.2.11_memory_corruption Name=anolisos:8.4:ANSA-2022:0001 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVulAutoRepairConfig

parameters.help_en:
The type of the vulnerability. Valid values:
cve: Linux software vulnerability.
sys: Windows system vulnerability
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞类型。取值：
-cve：Linux软件漏洞
-sys：Windows系统漏洞
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The list of vulnerabilities that can be automatically fixed
parameters.help_zh: 可自动修复的漏洞列表
parameters.name: vul_auto_repair_config_list

parameters.help_en: The reason for adding the vulnerabilities that can be automatically fixed
parameters.help_zh: 添加可自动化修复漏洞的原因说明
parameters.name: reason

Code.description_en: The result code. A value of 200 indicates success. Any other value indicates failure. You can use this field to determine the cause of the failure
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

Message.description_en: The detailed information about the error code

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值：

true：是
false：否
